name: aws
description: AWS audit + security sources via SigV4-signed API calls. Accepted auth modes: sigv4.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable, unique connection id -- the cursor key and metric/log/DLQ label.

fields.name: access_key_id
fields.description: Access key ID (prefer credential_secret in production).

fields.name: credential_secret
fields.description: Secret reference ('vault:<mount>/data/<path>:<key>', e.g. vault:kv/data/aws/prod:credentials -- the literal data segment names the KV v2 mount) for this connection's credentials. ESO materialises it; the app resolves it at fetch time. Prefer this over inline credential fields in production.

fields.name: output_format
